title: SurfSmooth
description: Tool for smoothing data on surfaces using various methods.

surface.description: Option for specifying the surface to smooth or the domain over which DSET is defined.
surface.title: Surface File

method.description: Name of smoothing method to use. Choose from: HEAT_07, HEAT_05, LM, NN_geom
method.title: Smoothing Method

input_data.description: File containing data (in 1D or NIML format). Required for HEAT_05 and HEAT_07 methods.
input_data.title: Input Data

target_fwhm.description: Blur so that the final FWHM of the data is TF mm. Only for HEAT_07 method.
target_fwhm.title: Target FWHM

fwhm.description: Effective Full Width at Half Maximum for smoothing. Required for HEAT_05 and optional for HEAT_07 methods.
fwhm.title: FWHM

number_iterations.description: Number of smoothing iterations (default is 100 for LM and NN_geom, -1 for HEAT methods).
number_iterations.title: Number of Iterations

output_file.description: Name of output file. Default based on method being used.
output_file.title: Output File

band_pass_frequency.description: Bandpass frequency for LM method (0 < k < 10).
band_pass_frequency.title: Bandpass Frequency

lambda_mu.description: Lambda and Mu parameters for LM method. Sample values are: 0.6307 and -0.6732.
lambda_mu.title: Lambda and Mu parameters

interp_weights.description: Set interpolation weights for LM method. Options: Equal, Fujiwara, Desbrun.
interp_weights.title: Interpolation Weights

node_mask.description: Apply operations only to nodes listed in the given mask.
node_mask.title: Node Mask

surface_output.description: Writes the surface with smoothed coordinates to disk. For LM and NN_geom methods.
surface_output.title: Surface Output

use_neighbors_outside_mask.description: Allow value from a node neighboring node n to contribute to the value at n even if the neighbor is not in the mask.
use_neighbors_outside_mask.title: Use Neighbors Outside Mask

talk_suma.description: Send progress with each iteration to SUMA for real-time visualization.
talk_suma.title: Talk to SUMA

refresh_rate.description: Maximum number of updates to SUMA per second.
refresh_rate.title: Refresh Rate
